title: ERD Studio model template
description: A model template: .erd-studio/templates/{id}.json. Preset columns offered when creating a model from the canvas. In column names and descriptions, {name} is the model name minus its prefix; bridge templates also get {left} and {right}. Reference: https://github.com/liam-machine/erd-studio/blob/main/docs/semantic-domain-json-reference.md#model-templates-erd-studiotemplatesidjson

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editors outside VS Code. Ignored by ERD Studio.

id.description: Unique across all template files — a duplicate id is skipped with a warning.

label.description: Name shown in the template picker.

prefix.description: Model name prefix, e.g. dim_ or fct_. Empty for none.

requiresLeftEntity.description: Bridge templates: ask for a left entity ({left}).

requiresRightEntity.description: Bridge templates: ask for a right entity ({right}).

columns.description: Preset columns. The full column shape is carried through to the created model; invalid values are dropped.

dataType.description: SQL data type, e.g. STRING, INTEGER, DECIMAL(18,2).

isPrimaryKey.description: Primary key. Only include when true.

isForeignKey.description: Foreign key intent. Only include when true.

isNaturalKey.description: Business identifier. Only include when true.

scdType.description: Dimension columns: how the attribute handles change.

additiveType.description: Fact measures: how the measure aggregates across dimensions.
